lane:
كلثب

كَلْثَبٌ and كُلَاثِبٌ _Contracted_ [_in hand_ or _mind_]: _avaricious:_ (K:) _dissembling,_ or _using craft,_ or _deceit, in affairs:_ app. a dial. syn. of كَلْتَبٌ. (TA.) See also كَلْبَثٌ.
